moisture_pct.quote: It contained only 36.1 per cent. of moisture, whereas the moisture content should range from 45 to 50 per cent.

fat_pct.quote: The fat was 47.8 per cent. calculated on the dry matter, and the label claimed "45 per cent. matiere grasse."

salt_pct.quote: The salt, 1.21 per cent., was low, as this cheese generally contains about 2 per cent. of salt.

ammonia.reason: Surface deacidification and amino-acid deamination by Brevibacterium linens/Geotrichum raises rind pH and NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Indole ++++ and p-cresol trace from Trp/Tyr catabolism by smear bacteria give barnyard note.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from rennet/plasmin proteolysis, partly debittered by smear peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue methyl-ketone dominance.

browning.reason: Maillard between proteolysis-derived amino groups and residual galactose on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus citrate metabolism, partially masked by washed-rind sulfur.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: 170 mg/kg 3-methylbutanoic plus 53 mg/kg butanoic and 30 mg/kg hexanoic from lipolysis/Leu catabolism.

creaminess.reason: Around 45% fat-in-dry-matter and 47% moisture give smooth supple high-fat paste.

crumbliness.reason: Rennet-lactic supple paste with solubilized calcium, not friable or granular.

firmness.reason: Soft washed-rind square holds shape but deforms easily at 45-50% moisture.

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol rated ++++ major from phenylalanine catabolism by yeast/smear flora.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate only traces plus 2-heptanone/2-nonanone + from beta-oxidation.

goaty.reason: Cow milk with no 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goat markers and low caproic intensity.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and benzaldehyde reduced to alcohols during ripening.

melt.reason: pH ~6.3 solubilizes colloidal calcium so intact casein network flows on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid lipoxygenase by Geotrichum/P. camemberti.

oil_off.reason: Soft high-moisture fat matrix releases moderate free oil when melted.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make with no wood-smoke guaiacol/phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: 165 mg/kg acetic acid plus 280 mg/kg propionic+2-methylpropionic from heterofermentative flora.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-kneading, acid-rennet curd gives flow without extensibility.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Dimethyl disulfide ++ and trisulfide trace from methionine catabolism by Brevibacterium.

sweet.reason: Low residual lactose balanced by lactones and reduced Strecker alcohols.

umami.reason: Glutamate and savory peptides from rennet plus smear surface proteolysis.
